text: House Concurrent Resolution 106 - Introduced HOUSE CONCURRENT RESOLUTION NO. 106 BY GRASSLEY and B. MEYER A Concurrent Resolution to provide for adjournment sine 1 die. 2 BE IT RESOLVED BY THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES, 3 THE SENATE CONCURRING, That when adjournment is had 4 on Friday, October 2, 2026, it shall be the final 5 adjournment of the 2026 Extraordinary Session of the 6 Ninety-first General Assembly. 7 -1- LSB 8509HQ (8) 91 1/ 1
